newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's upgrades Bridgestone Finance Europe's MTN.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Bridgestone Finance Europe's MTN.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had upgraded its rating on $400 million in Euro medium-term notes of Bridgestone Finance Europe BV, a wholly owned unit of Bridgestone Corp, to A2 from A3.

Moody's said in a statement that the upgrade was in reponse to Bridgestone Corp's recent decision to convert a keepwell agreement between itself and Bridgestone Finance Europe to an unconditional and irrevocable guarantee by the parent for the benefit of the medium-term noteholders.
